from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out-4/play/users/u042/system/state/workspace')
programs=base/'programs'; programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
prog='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 5 for v in row)]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 5 for r in range(h))]
    row_starts = [0] + [r + 1 for r in sep_rows]
    row_ends = sep_rows + [h]
    col_starts = [0] + [c + 1 for c in sep_cols]
    col_ends = sep_cols + [w]
    nr, nc = len(row_starts), len(col_starts)
    # The non-reference tile contains the pattern to reproduce.
    pattern = None
    for i in range(nr):
        for j in range(1, nc):
            tile = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(col_starts[j], col_ends[j])] for r in range(row_starts[i], row_ends[i])]
            if any(v != 0 and v != 5 for row in tile for v in row):
                pattern = [[v != 0 and v != 5 for v in row] for row in tile]
                break
        if pattern is not None:
            break
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i in range(nr):
        ref = next((grid[r][c] for r in range(row_starts[i], row_ends[i]) for c in range(col_starts[0], col_ends[0]) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 5)), 0)
        for j in range(nc):
            for dr in range(row_ends[i] - row_starts[i]):
                for dc in range(col_ends[j] - col_starts[j]):
                    out[row_starts[i] + dr][col_starts[j] + dc] = ref if pattern[dr][dc] else 0
    return out
'''
path=programs/'task-332eb48b.py'; path.write_text(prog)

prog='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row[0] != 0 and all(v == row[0] for v in row)]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    dividers = {grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols}
    row_starts = [0] + [r + 1 for r in sep_rows]
    row_ends = sep_rows + [h]
    col_starts = [0] + [c + 1 for c in sep_cols]
    col_ends = sep_cols + [w]
    nr, nc = len(row_starts), len(col_starts)
    pattern = None
    for i in range(nr):
        for j in range(1, nc):
            tile = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(col_starts[j], col_ends[j])] for r in range(row_starts[i], row_ends[i])]
            if any(v != 0 and v not in dividers for row in tile for v in row):
                pattern = [[v != 0 and v not in dividers for v in row] for row in tile]
                break
        if pattern is not None:
            break
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i in range(nr):
        ref = next((grid[r][c] for r in range(row_starts[i], row_ends[i]) for c in range(col_starts[0], col_ends[0]) if grid[r][c] != 0 and grid[r][c] not in dividers), 0)
        for j in range(nc):
            for dr in range(row_ends[i] - row_starts[i]):
                for dc in range(col_ends[j] - col_starts[j]):
                    out[row_starts[i] + dr][col_starts[j] + dc] = ref if pattern[dr][dc] else 0
    return out
'''
